title: Topic 2.1: The Bible as a Guide

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE BIBLE AS A GUIDE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.1: The Bible as a Guide

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Bible as a Guide. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should the Bible guide us in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the benefits of reading the Bible
2. read the Bible always to grow spiritually

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: THE BIBLE AS A GUIDE
This lesson teaches The Bible as a Guide for Grade 5 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the benefits of reading the Bible
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. read the Bible always to grow spiritually
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe The Bible as a Guide using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about The Bible as a Guide above.
2. Explain The Bible as a Guide to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand The Bible as a Guide.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Bible as a Guide with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is The Bible as a Guide important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should the Bible guide us in daily life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the benefits of reading the Bible
2. read the Bible always to grow spiritually

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
